item.title: A board agents can claim work from: Vercel Board, hands on
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. Board turns “who is working on what” into the return value of one claim. The bill arrives as a network round trip per operation, 654 ms on this machine. 1. How many agents a Markdown list survives# One agent working alone can keep its queue in a TODO.md. It reads the file, ticks a box, commits.
